description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git command options, specifically focusing on rev-parse, rev-list, and other related commands with glob patterns, exclusions, and refspec options. It contains test cases and functions to compare expected outputs with actual outputs of Git commands related to refs and revisions.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with a given message by writing to a file, adding it, and committing.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares the output of git commands with different arguments to verify references and revisions matching expected patterns.
